seededFrom.note: The 0N-*.md specs were the INPUT to the prior phase and their HMA-side deliverables already shipped. This phase seeds from the RESIDUAL those specs left plus the still-open subset of the 2026-07-16 assessment. Neither document is an open work list; both require re-verification against HEAD during /kbd-assess.

assessmentMethod.note: User-directed: /kbd-assess must run with adversarial review and sycophancy-correction applied to every evaluative claim.

changes.title: Repair and defend the vendored openspec mirrors
changes.note: Restores the green baseline. Two gates red: check-skill-contracts.mjs (40 errors, working tree) and check-git-url-discovery.sh (red on clean HEAD). Blocks all other changes.

decisions.codex: MANAGED (user, task 1.2) — openspec init --tools codex; the 10 stale .codex/skills/openspec-* duplicates removed because Codex reads shared skills from .agents/ (project.json agents_config.codex.skill_dir). The 35 pack-owned .codex skills are retained.
decisions.kimi: MIGRATION ACCEPTED — .kimi -> .kimi-code is intentional upstream behavior; .kimi dropped from the contract check harness list.

scopeAdditions: B-2 (check-git-url-discovery.sh red on clean HEAD, 'expected 30 public skills, found 36') was found during assessment review and fixed here; both hardcoded counts (30/50) are now derived from skills/ and .agents/skills.
audit.sh failed open on any unknown mode; a fail-closed guard was added (exit 2) because every acceptance criterion invoking 'audit.sh <mode>' could otherwise pass by typo.
AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md still stated OpenSpec 1.6.0+; aligned with the bumped pin (doc-consistency does not catch floors).

qa.idempotence: proven across two openspec update --force + normalize cycles; git diff clean

changes.title: Simulated-consumer install proof
changes.note: Executable half of G1. Does NOT prove prometheus-companion can consume the package — that repo is a 2-commit scaffold.

qa.pathIsolation: proven empirically — source tree deliberately broken (undeclared skill + deleted mirror) made the source's own gate fail while the consumer proof still passed

adversarialReview.headline: The negative suite scored 5/5 against a stub that read no input — it lacked a positive control, the exact defect class it exists to catch.

changes.notClaimed: This does NOT demonstrate that prometheus-companion can consume the package (that repo is a 2-commit scaffold). It demonstrates that a generic consumer following the documented contract can. G1'' remains on the Companion's roadmap.

changes.title: Make the refiner's Verify stage honest
changes.note: Blocking task 1.0 defines what replay means; may legitimately become a docs-only change.

decisions.replay: STRUCTURED REPLAY + HONEST BODY (user, task 1.0). Optional --replay '<command>' recorded on the ticket; --verify executes it and FAILS when it still reproduces. When absent, Verify prints 'replay: NOT RECORDED' and keeps replayed:false so silence is visible.
decisions.evalCase: REMOVED, NOT IMPLEMENTED. Evals are generated (3/skill, templated from the description by generate-skill-evals.mjs), the shape asserts skill ACTIVATION not a bug, and no runner executes them — check-skill-contracts.mjs only counts. A hand-added case is erased on the next regeneration. The promise was deleted from SKILL.md with the reason recorded, rather than faked.

adversarialReview.headline: Task 1.3 was annotated honestly but siblings 2.2/2.3 and the SPEC DELTA still asserted the removed eval-coverage behavior — a normative SHALL that was false on landing, inside a requirement titled 'the Verify stage keeps every promise its skill body makes'.

changes.title: Resolve tauri-tray template rot
changes.note: Blocking task 1.1 decides gate-vs-delete. Artifacts are templates, not .rs files.

decisions.why: Measuring first found tray.rs.template did NOT compile (E0596), so the scaffold had been shipping broken code. Deleting would have removed a broken artifact; the gate is what FOUND it.

defectsFound: E0596: apply_accessory_policy(app: &App) cannot call set_activation_policy (needs &mut App) — shipped to every scaffolded project
clippy::let_unit_value: `let _ =` on a unit-returning call, found by the gate immediately after the E0596 fix
unquoted heredoc in scaffold-tauri-tray.sh command-substituted a backticked `&mut App` out of the printed guidance (introduced and fixed in this change)

adversarialReview.headline: --fast printed 'PASS — every rendered template builds' with a deliberately broken tray.rs, exit 0. Third instance this phase of a checker that could not fail.

changes.outOfScopeFinding: 43 .rs files across 4 crates under assets/templates/rust/ are ungated by any build — the same defect class at 15x scale. Recorded as design.md D-3; NOT fixed here.

changes.title: Decide prom-hook-dispatch and align W6.x numbering
changes.note: W6.x sequences are offset by one across docs/03 and docs/05; renumber a whole sequence.

decisions.promHookDispatch: DROPPED from this repo's DoD (user, task 1.1); owned by prometheus-skill-system. This repo has no crates/, ships no Rust binaries, and every path the remedy names is the skill-system's layout.
decisions.numbering: ALIGN ALL to the architecture review §6 (user). Scope was larger than planned: FOUR sequences had diverged, not two.

changes.scopeGrowth: The plan assumed two lists offset by one. Reading the actual source of truth found four: the review, docs/03, the SHIPPED skill, and the docs/05 table. docs/05 turned out to be a REMEDY index mislabelled with W-numbers — relabelling it R6.x removed the collision at its root.

adversarialReview.note: 5 of 6 fixed; 1 WARNING accepted as a limitation and recorded as design.md D-4.
adversarialReview.judgeVerifiedRenumbering: The judge read the review §6 directly and confirmed the renumbering is correct against it.

changes.acceptedLimitation: check-w6-mapping.sh freezes agreement between LOCAL artifacts only; it cannot read the external review, so a remap all three shared would pass. Recorded as design.md D-4.

changes.title: Cut v2.0.0-alpha.3
changes.note: Last. The only outward-facing act in the phase; the first tag consumers pin must be green.

runtimeMode.note: prometheus kbd status reports 'KBD mode: legacy'; typed commands return 'runtime has not been initialized' and the control plane at 127.0.0.1:7892 is unreachable. In legacy mode the file-based ledger IS canonical, so progress.json is written directly. 'prometheus kbd migrate' (inventory) reports journalMigrationRequired=false, uncertainRows=0, invalidFiles=0. 'migrate --apply' was NOT run — out of scope for this phase and not requested.

redBaseline.note: Two gates fail before any work starts; both pre-existing, neither introduced by this phase. c300 closes both.
